Bassett CEO to retire after 26-year tenure
November 19, 2026 | 9:54 pm CST
Bassett CEO to retire after 26-year tenure

Rob Spilman, the long-tenured CEO at Bassett Furniture, will retire on January 31, 2027, and be replaced by Anthony (Tony) Chivari. Spilman will continue as executive chairman, focusing on overall strategic direction.
BASSETT, Va. — Rob Spilman, chairman and CEO of Bassett Furniture Industries Inc., announced that he will retire from his position effective January 31, 2027, after years in that leadership role.

Spilman will continue to serve Bassett, which ranks #61 on the FDMC 300 list, as executive chairman, focusing on overall strategic direction, organizational development, guiding the product assortment, and working with the board of directors to maintain effective corporate governance.

“It has been a privilege to lead the company that I grew up with for the past 26 years as CEO," said Spilman. "Our team has navigated the disruption of our legacy manufacturing model and the evolution to a multi-channel provider of aspirational custom-made home furnishings during an extremely challenging era for our industry in general. Our core values of fiscal conservatism and integrity and our strong consumer brand built over many decades are the foundation for our optimistic outlook to the future in an extremely competitive environment where many of our former competitors have ceased to exist.”

Anthony (Tony) Chivari, Bassett’s executive vice president of sales and marketing, will succeed Spilman as CEO effective February 1. Chivari joined Bassett in October 2023, leading the company’s digital transformation. His role expanded to leadership for all sales channels – Retail, Traditional Wholesale, and E-Commerce, as well as Marketing and Product Development.

Before joining Bassett, Chivari held senior leadership positions with companies well known among consumers: Spiegel, Things Remembered, The Mark Travel Corporation and 1-800-Flowers.com. He also served as CEO of Gem Shopping Network.

Throughout his career, Chivari has led digital transformation initiatives across multiple industries, combining strategic vision with hands-on operational leadership to build teams and strengthen business results.
Chivari graduated with honors from the University of Chicago with a degree in Economics and earned his MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business while working full time at Spiegel.

“I’m honored and grateful for the opportunity to lead Bassett into its next chapter," he said. "We have an exceptional team, a strong brand with a rich heritage, and a solid foundation for future growth. I’m excited about the opportunities ahead and look forward to working with Rob and the entire Bassett team, particularly the next generation of leaders who we recently promoted, to build on our legacy and realize the full potential of this great company.”

Spilman added, “I am excited to work with Tony in my new capacity of executive chairman. Tony (Chivari) is an able strategist, has considerably strengthened our marketing programs and digital performance, and has earned the respect of our team since joining us three years ago.”

Bill Warden, Bassett’s Lead Director added, “The Board of Directors thank Rob for his many years of exceptional leadership and look forward to an exciting new chapter under Tony as Bassett prepares to enter its 125th year.”
